title: The amethyst reads white after the first gunship seat: the base's heat and the family's thermal wrote the same membrane emissive; one writer now
context: Owner, 2026-11-05 (entry 2026-11-05-owner-the-amethyst-reads-white-in-the-nest-and-the-waves-fine-in-the-quiver-s-seeker): CUTIS-CORE AMETHYST purple in the Quiver's seeker, a plain white mass with a hint of purple and two purple pearl dots in the nest and the waves. Measured first, headless (a scratch probe: index.html?...&creatures=pearl&skip=defence&sector=2&day=2.95&gunship=station, three barbed and twelve amoeba spawned ahead of the hull, every Pearl membrane material's uHeat read through the renderer hook, one seat taken through mountGunship + the briefing's skip and left through the TANK button): every membrane's heat 000000 before the seat, ffffff on the cored and 000000 on the soft 0.3 s into it, c4c4c4 on ALL of them 1.8 s into it, and c4c4c4 after leaving, still after a second seat. c4c4c4 is linear .55, HEAT.warm: the shader mixes the skin 55 % toward white (MEMBRANE_FRAG: color = mix(color, white, uHeat.r)). The before and after screenshots are the owner's two pictures: saturated purple, then a white mass with purple pearls. The Quiver's single barbed is seen before the game's first seat; the nests' guards and the waves after it.
outcome: The cause, read then confirmed by the probe: two writers of one emissive. src/td-tab.js's pilot host runs thermalHeat.set(on) (src/fx/thermal-heat.js, warm .55 over the base, the hull, the towers and creatureEnemies.roots()) and then creatureEnemies.thermal(on) (src/fx/creature-pearl.js thermal: a cored tier's skin hot, white at 1.4, a soft tier's cold). Both wrote the same THREE.Color, the kit material's emissive bound as uHeat, each with its own saved copy. The base's ran first and took every membrane to .55; the family's lazy `cold ??=` snapshot took that warm value as cold; on leaving, the base restored black and the family's restore put .55 back, for the rest of the game, soft tiers included (the ivories whiter too). The base's re-apply every second (the slow pick-up of parts that load while thermal is on) also took the hot and the cold skins to warm one second into every seat, so the FLIR's cored-hot / soft-cold read lasted a second. Fixed (commit on overnight-2026-10-23): the membranes are the family's alone, `userData.ownHeat`, which heatMaterial skips; the family takes a pool's cold emissive when the pool is made, not at the first seat; thermal(on) keeps the state and a pool made while the seat is on takes it (heatPool). test/pearl-thermal.mjs (new) plays the game's order: base on, family on, base re-applied, a cored and a soft pool made in the seat, base off, family off, a second round; asserts hot/cold held through the re-apply and every membrane black at intensity 1 after each seat. npm test 315 programs, npm run check, npm run architecture green. The probe after the fix: 000000 after the first and the second seat; at 1.8 s into the seat the cored still ffffff and the soft 000000. scripts/browser-test.mjs --gunship is red at the seat's program-warm count (106 -> 119, allowed 4) on the unfixed tree too, with the same numbers: a base red, not this change. The earlier purple rounds (2026-10-18, 10-19, 11-02) measured from spawns and the seeker without a seat, so each saw its fix land and the owner saw white again after the gunship came.
alternatives: The entry's candidates, ruled out by the probe before any knob moved: the glints and the pearl's clear coat in daylight (the membrane's colour is unlit by the scene: its light is fixed in the shader), tone mapping (the game's renderer runs none), the wire look's cyan edges (the white read follows the seat, not the look).
Keeping both writers and only taking the family's cold snapshot eagerly: the base's re-apply would still turn the hot and the cold skins warm a second into every seat.

Removing creatureEnemies.roots() from the base's warm list instead of a flag: the pearls' clear-coat cores and the shadows under the same roots would lose their warmth in the FLIR; the flag keeps them.
evidence: node test/pearl-thermal.mjs (red on the unfixed tree at 'the base's re-apply leaves the hot skin hot', actual .55; green after)
npm test (315 programs), npm run check, npm run architecture

the scratch probe's readings before: BEFORE 000000, SEAT+.3s cored ffffff@1.4 / soft 000000@0, SEAT+1.8s all c4c4c4@1, AFTER all c4c4c4@1, AFTER 2 all c4c4c4@1; after the fix: SEAT+1.8s cored ffffff / soft 000000, AFTER and AFTER 2 all 000000@1
node scripts/browser-test.mjs --gunship: red at the program count 106 -> 119 on both trees (stashed fix, then restored)
src/fx/thermal-heat.js heatMaterial (userData.ownHeat), src/fx/creature-pearl.js heatPool/thermal, src/fx/cutis-maku/shaders.js MEMBRANE_FRAG's heat mix, src/td-tab.js pilotHost.thermal
